QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Otherworldly Luck Guide
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Otherworldly Luck Guide> Event#n

#bEvent Period#k
TKTKTK QRQRQR - TKTKTK QRQRQR

#bEvent Details#k
As a token of gratitude for your help, #b#p9400424##k will provide aid to those who collapsed from exhaustion with #bOtherworldly Luck#k when reviving.

#e<Otherworldly Luck>#n#k
- Chance to prevent EXP Loss on revival
- Chance to revive at current location
- Chance to retain Buffs on revival

A random effect activates upon reviving, and the 3 effects cannot stack.
While #bOtherworldly Luck#k is active, similar buffs and cash items cannot be used.
